title: EU Packaging Hub — Country EPR data

provenance.description: Per-fact provenance: verification status, the specific source for THIS fact, when it was checked, and its validity window. Attach to individual tariffs/obligations rather than relying on the country-level `verified` boolean.

status.description: official = primary law/government source; operator_published = PRO/scheme price list; secondary_source = reputable third party; inferred = derived from PPWR/interpretation, no country-specific source; unverified = not yet checked; not_applicable = fact does not exist for this country (e.g. no public per-material tariff); unknown = open question.

sourceUrl.description: The specific source backing THIS fact (may differ from country-level sources).

validFrom.description: Start of the tariff/obligation validity period.

competentAuthority.description: National competent authority/regulator (analogous to register.operator; regulatory context, not a fee claim)

legalBasis.description: National legal basis for packaging EPR (e.g. 'VerpackG; VerpackDG from 12.08.2026'). Compiled from project research + cross-checks.

exists.description: Does a dedicated national PACKAGING producer register exist? (LV: false as of 2026; IE: false — Repak membership instead)

arRequiredForForeignSellers.description: Authorised representative required for sellers without local establishment; null = unverified

arProvenance.description: Provenance of the authorised-representative obligation (often `inferred` from PPWR Art. 45 rather than a country-specific source).

membershipRequired.description: true / false / 'state-run' (e.g. HR pays Fund directly)

rates.description: Indicative household-packaging rates in EUR per kg. null = no reliable data.

ecoModulation.description: Short note on bonus/malus system if notable

ratesProvenance.description: Provenance of the per-material PRO rates (e.g. operator_published from a price-list PDF, or not_applicable when schemes price by private contract).

extraTaxes.description: Separate national taxes outside the EPR scheme (ES plastic excise, HU termékdíj, EE pakendiaktsiis...)

material.description: Material this tax targets, used by the calculator. Explicit is preferred over guessing from the summary text.

appliesConditionally.description: true = liability is unresolved for a foreign B2C distance seller (e.g. ES plastic excise). The calculator surfaces it as a 'verify' caveat and never auto-adds it to a total.

deMinimis.description: e.g. '0 kg — first unit triggers duty' or 'full obligations from 50,000 kg/yr'

reporting.description: How and when packaging volumes must be declared in this country.

deadlines.description: Human-readable filing deadlines, e.g. 'Annual declaration by 31 March for the previous year'.

zeroDeclaration.description: Must a nil return be filed even with zero volume? null = unknown.

drs.description: Deposit-return system for beverage containers (separate from packaging EPR).

active.description: true = live beverage DRS in 2026; false = none/planned; null = unknown

verified.description: true only when register URL fetched AND rates come from an official tariff source. CI must reject verified:true without at least one sources[].official === true.
